findings.finding: The 45-case ledger has no explicit accessibility text-size case/parameter and no required scroll-position or multi-capture coverage for tall product pages. A single first-viewport capture of account, personal-provider settings or a long diary can satisfy every named case while omitting product controls/content and the required large-text check.
findings.evidence: Design decision 7 and the visual specification require accessibility/keyboard stress checks. Every current case has only id/route/state/required/status/harmony/ios/review; no textSize/captureRegions/scroll-position contract is present.
findings.requestedChange: Add explicit large-text cases for representative ring/form/long-content layouts with documented text-size settings, and require top/bottom or identified content regions for scrolling account/settings/long-content cases. Bind all required captures to the future parity validator and review.
